candidate_requirements.requirement: Clarify the swelling and relevant associated/urinary symptoms.
candidate_requirements.rationale: Swelling alone does not establish its mechanism.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: An open symptom enquiry is acceptable; volunteered urine/breathing information needs no repeat request.

candidate_requirements.requirement: Seek disease and medication context, including recent changes or treatment response.
candidate_requirements.rationale: Comorbid disease and medicine exposure may change the working differential.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: General personal medical-history and medicine-review questions are acceptable; do not require guessing rheumatoid arthritis or a particular medicine.

candidate_requirements.requirement: Request existing urine-protein and serum albumin/renal-function evidence.
candidate_requirements.rationale: The suspected renal syndrome is not laboratory-confirmed from symptoms.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Named urine/protein and relevant blood-result requests count even when the selected material cannot supply them.
